top_signals.title: US Navy, Boeing ink first MQ-25A Stingray production contract
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Navy awarded a $562 million fixed-price incentive contract to Boeing on Monday to start Lot 1 Low Rate Initial Production of the MQ-25A Stingray.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
